canonical_start.non_authority: Role binding does not add buildability, walkability, distance, timing, morphology, structure-layout, or backend geometry thresholds.

local_personal_crossing_and_verticality.witness: #224 plus bootstrap-region-recipe-v0.1 and early-glider-mobility-contract-v0.1; exact geometry remains an Implementation/human-play proof

post_flight_specialization.eligibility: accepted AUTH-0094/AUTH-0093 nonzero geological opportunity only
post_flight_specialization.selection_rule: bind only an eligible authored association; geological ranking may describe eligible candidates but cannot silently choose a gameplay role

guild_destination.site_witness: AUTH-0096 physical surface support plus AUTH-0097 observed-open ray
guild_destination.reachability: explicit route-planner assertion; never inferred from raw site evidence
guild_destination.selection_rule: first explicitly reachable canonical BootstrapGuildDestinationPolicy candidate

first_freight_opportunity.witness: BootstrapFreightOpportunity.firstOpportunity plus an eligible post-flight Copper association and an operational #467 cargo-transfer anchor

determinism.tie_break: Use only an accepted canonical order after capability eligibility has been established; source order is never suitability evidence.
determinism.replan: If a required capability witness is absent, reject the affected plan/scope and request replan; never inject resources or fabricate geometry/capability.
determinism.fail_closed: If first-flight transitive inputs, exact provenance, or a required accepted capability witness cannot be established, output FAIL_CLOSED_* rather than a guaranteed role.

product_invariant: PERSONAL MOBILITY IS CHEAP. LOGISTICS ARE NOT.
